answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the karst of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the delta of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
